verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਅਤੀਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan sobhaa dhirag dhirasaT giaan ga(n)m dhirasaT dhiaan prabh dharas ateet hai ||

en.bdb: Seeing the well adored God-like True Guru with one's eyes, the devoted Sikh of the True Guru acquires the divine knowledge. By the focusing of mind in the vision of Lord Guru, one is freed from watching the worldly merriments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਪਰੈ ਜਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਅਲਖ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਨਾਸ ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat parai surat sabadh parai jaas baas alakh subaas naas reet hai ||

en.bdb: When the sound of Naam Simran enters the ears, the ability of concentration of a Guru's disciple turns away from other sounds and modes. The fragrance of the Guru's words that is so supernatural, the nostrils become free of all other smells.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਹਿਤ ਰਸ ਕਰ ਅਸਪਰਸ ਪਰਸਨ ਕਰਾਜੀਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ras rasanaa rahit rasanaa rahit ras kar asaparas parasan karaajeet hai ||

en.bdb: The tongue of practitioner of meditation becomes engrossed in the pleasure of Naam Simran and it becomes bereft of all other worldly tastes. The hands when able to touch and feel the untouchable Lord are freed from the impressions of touching worldly things:

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਗਵਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਗਵਨ ਚਰਨ ਗੰਮਿ ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੯॥
verses.translit_en: charan gavan ga(n)m gavan charan ga(n)m aas piaas bisam bisavaiaas pria preet hai ||279||

en.bdb: The feet of a Guru-oriented person tread towards the path of the True Guru. They give up travelling or going in other directions. For him his lone desire of meeting the beloved Lord is unique and marvellous. (279)
